description: This file defines the interface for the TextureGL class, which manages OpenGL textures within the ANGLE project. It includes class declarations, related structures, and method signatures for texture operations.

classes.name: TextureGL
classes.description: Class managing OpenGL textures, providing methods for texture data management, storage, and state synchronization.

classes.name: LUMAWorkaroundGL
classes.description: Structure holding luminance workaround settings for a texture level.

classes.name: LevelInfoGL
classes.description: Structure containing format and workaround information for each mip level of a TextureGL.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the texture is destroyed.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Sets image data for a specific mip level.

methods.name: setSubImage
methods.description: Sets a sub-region of the texture image.

methods.name: setCompressedSubImage
methods.description: Sets a sub-region of compressed image data.

methods.name: copySubImage
methods.description: Copies a sub-region of image data.

methods.name: copyTexture
methods.description: Copies texture data from another texture.

methods.name: copySubTexture
methods.description: Copies a sub-region from another texture.

methods.name: setStorage
methods.description: Allocates immutable storage for the texture.

methods.name: setImageExternal
methods.description: Sets external image as texture data.

methods.name: setImageExternal (Stream overload)
methods.description: Sets external stream as texture data.

methods.name: bindTexImage
methods.description: Binds a surface as a texture image.

methods.name: setEGLImageTarget
methods.description: Sets an EGL image as texture data.

methods.name: syncState
methods.description: Synchronizes texture state with the context.

methods.name: hasAnyDirtyBit
methods.description: Checks if the texture has any dirty state.

methods.name: getNativeInternalFormat
methods.description: Returns internal format for a given image index.

methods.name: hasEmulatedAlphaChannel
methods.description: Checks if the texture level has an emulated alpha channel.
